verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly cover risk rules/lists, fraud reports, and preventing fraudulent disputes, which supports custom block/review/allow-style rule creation and fraud reporting; there's also mention of fraud-detection testing scenarios and 'advanced analytics' beyond approve/decline. However, no concrete evidence describes ML-generated fraud scores per transaction or a scoring UI/API distinctly from rule configuration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of ML-based fraud scoring output, detail on the rule-builder UI/logic (conditions, thresholds), and independent/hands-on confirmation of the scoring model's accuracy or usage.
